title: Amazon Return Rate by Category
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=amazon:order
| search return_flag=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as orders avg(return_flag) as return_rate by _time category
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Amazon return rate over time and breaks it out by category.
value: A category-level return rate highlights where repeat purchases are not matching expectations or sizing reality.
implementation: Send Amazon return rate events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Amazon return rate by category.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how Amazon return rate changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
